item.title: Petal 1.1.0
item.description:
## Petal 1.1.0
- **Copy Text (OCR):** read Thai and English from photos, screenshots and scanned PDFs, on your Mac. - **Cut Out:** remove photo backgrounds in one drop. - **PDF Tools:** password lock / unlock, watermark, page numbers and signatures. Undo in the page organizer. - **GIF / Video:** turn images into an animated GIF or a slideshow video; compress videos. - **Batch rename** in the Workspace (`Trip {n}`, `{date}`, …). - **Automation:** watch folders, ⌥⌘P for files selected in Finder, Finder Quick Actions and `petal://` links for Shortcuts. - **Folder access** in one place (welcome window and Settings), kept across updates. - **Thai language** (Settings → Language) and a cleaner menu bar panel with Update and Quit buttons. - A smaller ring that only shows tools that fit the file.

item.title: Petal 1.0.0
item.description:
## Petal 1.0.0
- Drag any file to bloom the ring: convert, compress, resize, edit, crop, annotate, redact. - PDF tools: merge files, organize pages (reorder, rotate, delete, extract) and split by page, every N pages or custom ranges. - Control panel in the menu bar, plus Workspace, History and Settings in the Manager. - Automatic updates.
